description:
Isaac Hayes performs "Shaft" at the 2002 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony. The Oscar-winning soul and funk legend Isaac Hayes brought the iconic Shaft theme to life and showed everyone exactly why he's a legend. Isaac Hayes was the first Black artist to win a non-acting Oscar for Best Original Song, and he was the first to win for a song that he wrote and performed himself.

– Song: "Shaft"
– Event: 2002 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony
